description: This file provides utility functions for dynamic type casting in PyTorch, including fetch_and_cast and cast_and_store functions, along with macros for handling various scalar types and complex types.

methods.name: fetch_and_cast
methods.description: Templated function to fetch a value with dynamic type and cast it to a static type.

methods.name: cast_and_store
methods.description: Templated function to cast a static type value into a dynamic type and store it into a pointer.
